# Stax

A reactive UI framework built on Effect. Signals for state, `Readable`s for
derivation, DOM elements as scoped `Effect`s, SSR/SSG with hydration by
default (SPA `mount` is a secondary path).

## Packages

- `@stax-ui/core` — reactive primitives. Re-exported by `@stax-ui/dom`; app
  code shouldn't import from `core` directly.
- `@stax-ui/dom` — DOM renderer, `$` element factories, control flow,
  animation, `Screen`, `Boundary`. The umbrella app-side import.
- `@stax-ui/router` — `Router`, `Route`, `Link`, `Outlet`.
- `@stax-ui/platform` — SSR/SSG runtime: `Platform.toHttpRoutes`,
  `buildStaticSite`, `makeClientLayer`.
- `@stax-ui/vite-plugin` — Vite plugin (`staxPlatform`) for SSR/SSG builds.
- `@stax-ui/form` — form schema + submit handling (Effect Schema). Optional.

Install (SSR-first):

```bash
pnpm add @stax-ui/dom @stax-ui/router @stax-ui/platform effect @effect/platform
pnpm add -D @stax-ui/vite-plugin vite
```

Install (SPA only, no SSR):

```bash
pnpm add @stax-ui/dom @stax-ui/router effect
pnpm add -D vite
```

## Bootstrap (SSR-first)

A Stax app has three pieces: a **server entry** (exports `router`/`app`/
`document` for the build), a **client entry** (calls `hydrate`), and a
**Vite config** that wires the plugin. `vite build && vite build --ssr
src/entry.ts` produces both bundles.

### `src/entry.ts` — server entry (SSG + dev SSR)

```ts
import { HttpApp, HttpRouter } from "@effect/platform";

import { Platform } from "@stax-ui/platform";

import { App } from "./App.js";
import { router } from "./routes.js";

// Consumed by staxPlatform at build time (SSG) — one HTML file per route.
export { router };
export const app = App;
export const document = {
  title: "My App",
  scripts: ["/src/client.ts"], // hydration entry
  styles: ["/styles.css"],
  head: '<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" />',
};

// Dev server: same routes handled through an HttpApp so `vite dev` can serve
// SSR-rendered pages without going through the SSG build.
const routes = Platform.toHttpRoutes(router, { app, document });
const httpApp = HttpRouter.empty.pipe(HttpRouter.concat(routes));
const handler = HttpApp.toWebHandler(httpApp);

export async function render(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
  return handler(req);
}
```

If your app uses services (`Context.Tag`), attach them via a layer stack that
the dev server threads through:

```ts
import { HttpApp, HttpRouter } from "@effect/platform";
import { Layer } from "effect";

import { Platform } from "@stax-ui/platform";

// Server-side layer stack (SSG + dev SSR). Use no-op impls for anything that
// only exists in the browser (localStorage, window, etc.).
export const layers = Layer.mergeAll(StorageNoOp /* , ... */);

const routes = Platform.toHttpRoutes(router, { app, document });
const httpApp = HttpRouter.empty.pipe(HttpRouter.concat(routes));

// toWebHandlerLayer peels app-defined requirements off the HttpApp so the
// returned handler only needs Scope (which the runtime supplies).
const { handler } = HttpApp.toWebHandlerLayer(httpApp, layers);

export async function render(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
  return handler(req);
}
```

### `src/client.ts` — client entry (hydration)

```ts
import "./styles.css";
import { Layer } from "effect";

import { hydrate } from "@stax-ui/dom/hydrate";
import { makeClientLayer } from "@stax-ui/platform";

import { App } from "./App.js";
import { router } from "./routes.js";

// makeClientLayer(router) provides NavigationContext + client control ctx.
// Merge additional live services (e.g. StorageLive) alongside it.
hydrate(App(), document.getElementById("root")!, {
  layers: Layer.mergeAll(makeClientLayer(router) /* , StorageLive */),
});
```

Note the import path: `@stax-ui/dom/hydrate`, not `@stax-ui/dom`.

### `vite.config.ts`

```ts
import { defineConfig } from "vite";

import { staxPlatform } from "@stax-ui/vite-plugin";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    staxPlatform({ mode: "ssg", entry: "src/entry.ts" }),
  ],
});
```

Build command:

```bash
vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry.ts
```

The plugin also strips server-only code (loaders, static-path generators)
from the client bundle.

### SPA-only path (no SSR)

If you don't want SSR, skip `entry.ts` / `client.ts` / the plugin and mount
directly. `mount` requires the DOM renderer layer.

```ts
import { Effect, Layer } from "effect";

import { $, DOMRendererLive, mount } from "@stax-ui/dom";
import { ClientControlCtx } from "@stax-ui/dom";

const App = () => $.div({}, "Hello");

Effect.runPromise(
  mount(App(), document.getElementById("root")!).pipe(
    Effect.scoped,
    Effect.provide(Layer.mergeAll(DOMRendererLive, ClientControlCtx)),
  ),
);
```

For a routed SPA, provide `makeClientLayer(router)` alongside the DOM
renderer, and render `Outlet({ router })` from the app root.

## Reactive primitives

### `Signal` — readable + writable state

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { Readable, Signal } from "@stax-ui/dom";

Effect.gen(function* () {
  const count = yield* Signal.make(0);

  yield* count.get;              // Effect<number>  — read
  yield* count.set(5);           // Effect<void>    — write
  yield* count.update((n) => n + 1);

  // Derive a Readable — no yield, no scope. `Readable.map` is a
  // static combinator (or pipeable: `count.pipe(Readable.map(fn))`).
  const doubled = Readable.map(count, (n) => n * 2);
});
```

`Signal.make` requires `Scope.Scope` — always yielded inside an `Effect.gen`
that itself lives under a scope (a component body, a service constructor).

### `Signal.Array` / `Signal.Map` / `Signal.Set` / `Signal.Struct`

Collection signals with in-place mutation methods. The array is the most
common:

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { Signal, type SignalArray } from "@stax-ui/dom";

interface Todo { id: string; text: string; done: boolean }

Effect.gen(function* () {
  const todos: SignalArray<Todo> = yield* Signal.Array.make<Todo>([]);

  yield* todos.push({ id: "1", text: "buy milk", done: false });
  yield* todos.modifyAt(0, (t) => ({ ...t, done: !t.done }));
  yield* todos.removeAt(0);
  yield* todos.set([]);          // whole-array replace (from Signal)
  yield* todos.update((arr) => arr.filter((t) => !t.done));

  const list = yield* todos.get; // readonly Todo[]
});
```

`Signal.Map`, `Signal.Set`, `Signal.Struct` follow the same pattern with
`.set/.delete/.clear` / add-remove / `.setField` mutators. Types
(`SignalMap<K, V>`, `SignalSet<T>`, `SignalStruct<T>`) are re-exported from
`@stax-ui/dom` too.

### `Readable` — read-only reactive value

The interface itself is minimal: `get: Effect<A>`, `changes: Stream<A>`,
`values: Stream<A>`, plus `pipe`. Everything else is a static combinator
in the `Readable` namespace — always called as `Readable.foo(source, ...)`
or piped as `source.pipe(Readable.foo(...))`. There are no combinator
methods on the instance.

```ts
import { Readable } from "@stax-ui/dom";

const one   = Readable.of(1);                        // constant Readable
const two   = Readable.map(one, (n) => n * 2);       // derive
const three = Readable.combine([one, two]);          // Readable<[1, 2]>

// Pipe-style is equivalent.
const four  = one.pipe(Readable.map((n) => n * 4));

// Normalize `T | Readable<T>` to always-Readable — useful in components
// whose props may be either.
const normalized = Readable.normalize(maybeReadable);

// Destructure typed fields as separate Readables.
const { text, done } = Readable.valuesAt(row, ["text", "done"]);
```

Full namespace: `Readable.of` / `.id`, `.make` (from a `get` Effect + `changes`
Stream factory), `.fromStream`, `.map`, `.flatMap`, `.zip`, `.zipWith`,
`.zipAll` / `.combine` (alias), `.filter`, `.dedupe`, `.dedupeWith`, `.tap`
(subscribe with an Effect), `.lift`, `.normalize`, `.valuesAt`, `.debug`,
`.isReadable`.

`Readable.Reactive<A>` = `A | Readable<A>`. Used pervasively for props
that should accept either a plain value or a reactive one; call
`Readable.normalize(input)` to lift to `Readable<A>` unconditionally.

For async work, use `AsyncReadable` (below) or hoist into a route loader.

### `AsyncReadable` — value | loading | error

Async-flavored Readable that carries `isLoading`, `value`
(`Option<A>`), `error` (`Option<E>`), plus `refetch()` and `reset()` actions.
Returns synchronously — the initial fetch runs in the background under the
caller's scope. `isLoading` reads `true` and `value` reads `None` on the
next line, so components render a loading UI immediately without any
`Boundary`. Wrap in `Boundary.suspense` when a blocking UX is wanted.

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { AsyncReadable } from "@stax-ui/dom";

Effect.gen(function* () {
  const user = yield* AsyncReadable.tryPromise(
    () => fetch(`/api/users/${id}`).then((r) => r.json()) as Promise<User>,
    (err) => new FetchError({ cause: err }),
  );

  // user.isLoading : Readable<boolean>
  // user.value     : Readable<Option<User>>
  // user.error     : Readable<Option<FetchError>>
  // user.refetch() : Effect<void>
  // user.reset()   : Effect<void>
});
```

Constructors: `AsyncReadable.make(() => Effect<A, E, R>)`,
`.promise(() => Promise<A>)`, `.tryPromise(() => Promise<A>, onError)`,
`.fromReadable(source, (a) => Effect<B, E, R>)` (recomputes when the
source changes; initial computation also non-suspending).

## Elements

Elements are `Effect<HTMLElement | SVGElement, E, Scope | RendererContext | R>`.
Use the `$` namespace for all element factories.

```ts
import { $ } from "@stax-ui/dom";

// (attrs?, ...children) — attrs are optional.
$.div({ class: "hero" }, $.h1("Title"), $.p("Body"));
$.p("just children, no attrs");
```

### Attributes

```ts
import { $, Readable } from "@stax-ui/dom";

$.div({
  // string, Readable<string>, ClassValue (array or mixed), or Readable of any.
  class: [
    "btn",
    Readable.map(isPrimary, (v) => (v ? "btn-primary" : "btn-secondary")),
    "print:hidden",
  ],

  // style: object of strings, Readable<string>, or a Readable<Record<...>>.
  style: { color: "red", fontSize: "16px" },

  // Boolean attrs: boolean or Readable<boolean>.
  disabled: isBusy,

  // data-* / aria-* pass through as attributes.
  "data-done": done,               // Readable<boolean> is fine
  "aria-label": "Delete",

  // Event handlers may return void OR Effect. Effect handlers are run in
  // the ambient scope.
  onClick: (e) =>
    Effect.gen(function* () {
      e.preventDefault();
      yield* handler();
    }),
});
```

Handler types are exported as `EventHandler<E>`:

```ts
import { EventHandler } from "@stax-ui/dom";

const onSubmit: EventHandler<SubmitEvent> = (e) => Effect.gen(function* () {
  e.preventDefault();
  yield* save();
});
```

### Children

Reactive text: pass a `Readable<string | number>` directly as a child.

```ts
const count = yield* Signal.make(0);

$.div("Count: ", count);                       // count updates the text node
$.span(text);                                  // text: Readable<string>
```

Wrapping components that forward children use `PermissiveChildren` — a
readonly array of children (elements, strings, numbers, Readables, or nested
arrays):

```ts
import { $, PermissiveChildren, Element } from "@stax-ui/dom";

export const Card = <E = never, R = never>(
  props: { class?: string },
  ...children: PermissiveChildren<E, R>
): Element.Element<HTMLDivElement, E, R> =>
  $.div({ class: ["card", props.class] }, children);
```

## Control flow

Reconciliation-based; every control-flow function is a thin wrapper over
`reconcile` from core.

### `when` — conditional

```ts
import { $, when } from "@stax-ui/dom";

when(isLoggedIn, {
  onTrue:  () => Dashboard(),
  onFalse: () => LoginForm(),
});
```

### `match` — pattern match on a value

```ts
import { match } from "@stax-ui/dom";

match(status, {
  cases: [
    { pattern: "loading", render: () => Spinner() },
    { pattern: "error",   render: () => ErrorMessage() },
    { pattern: "success", render: () => Content() },
  ],
  fallback: () => $.div("Unknown"),
});
```

Also: `matchOption(opt, { onSome, onNone })`,
`matchEither(either, { onRight, onLeft })`.

### `each` — keyed list

```ts
import { $, each, stagger } from "@stax-ui/dom";

each(todos, {
  container: () => $.ul({ class: "todo-list" }),
  key: (todo) => todo.id,
  render: (todoR /* Readable<Todo> */) => TodoItem({ todo: todoR }),
});
```

`each`'s **animation surface** is the headline feature; the config accepts
`animate` (enter/exit/move classes + optional stagger + optional group) and
`intro`:

```ts
each(todos, {
  key: (t) => t.id,
  container: () => $.ul(),
  render: (t) => TodoItem({ todo: t }),
  animate: {
    enterFrom: "opacity-0 -translate-y-2",
    enter:     "transition-all duration-300",
    enterTo:   "opacity-100 translate-y-0",
    exit:      "transition-all duration-300",
    exitTo:    "opacity-0",
    stagger:   stagger(50),                   // per-item delay
    move: {
      transform:  Animation.moveTranslate3d,  // FLIP reorder helper
      transition: "transition-transform duration-300",
    },
  },
  intro: true,                                // play enter on initial mount
});
```

Handler for `render`: receives a `Readable<A>` (or in the wrapping
component's case, a `Readable.Reactive<A>` that `Readable.normalize` will
lift to a Readable).

## Animation

### `animated` — wrap any element with an intro / hydration animation

```ts
import { $, animated, Animation } from "@stax-ui/dom";

animated(
  {
    animate: {
      enterFrom: "opacity-0 -translate-y-4",
      enter:     "transition-all duration-500",
      enterTo:   "opacity-100 translate-y-0",
    },
    intro: true,
  },
  () => $.h1("Hello"),
);
```

The second argument is a `() => Element` — deferred so the animation
runtime controls when the DOM node is materialized (matters for
hydration + group coordination).

### Groups + sequences

Animate multiple children in coordinated order. `Animation.sequence(n)`
returns an array of `AnimationGroup`s, each of which gates one element's
enter animation:

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { $, animated, Animation, OutletCtx } from "@stax-ui/dom";

export const HomePage = () =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const outlet = yield* OutletCtx;

    // Two groups, chained after the outlet's page-enter animation.
    const [headline, cards] = yield* Animation.sequence(2, {
      group: outlet.enter,
    });

    return yield* $.div(
      animated(
        { animate: { enterFrom: "opacity-0", enterTo: "opacity-100", group: headline }, intro: true },
        () => $.h1("Welcome"),
      ),
      each(items, {
        key: (i) => i.id,
        animate: {
          enterFrom: "opacity-0 translate-y-4",
          enter:     "transition-all duration-300",
          enterTo:   "opacity-100 translate-y-0",
          stagger:   stagger(100),
          group:     cards,
        },
        intro: true,
        render: (i) => Card({ item: i }),
      }),
    );
  });
```

Other helpers: `Animation.parallel(n)`, `Animation.awaitDone(group)` (wait
for a group's animations to finish), `Animation.skip(group)` (skip a
group's animation, useful for responsive breakpoints), `Animation.group(...)`
(construct a group manually).

Stagger helpers: `stagger(ms)`, `staggerFromCenter(ms)`, `staggerEased(ms, ease)`.

Move transforms for FLIP reorder: `Animation.moveTranslate`,
`Animation.moveTranslate3d`, `Animation.moveTranslateY`.

## Boundaries

### `Boundary.suspense` — async data with fallback

```ts
import { Boundary } from "@stax-ui/dom";

Boundary.suspense({
  render: () =>
    Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = yield* fetchUser(id);
      return yield* UserProfile({ user });
    }),
  fallback: () => $.div("Loading..."),
  catch: (error) => $.div("Error: ", String(error)),
  delay: "200 millis",                           // avoid loading flash
});
```

### `Boundary.error` — catch failures from a subtree

```ts
Boundary.error(
  () => riskyComponent(),
  (error) => $.div("Something went wrong: ", String(error)),
);
```

Idiom note: for route-level data loading, prefer `Route.static({ load })`
below — the loader runs at build time (SSG) or request time (SSR), so the
client renders resolved data without a suspense flash.

## Screen

Reactive media queries.

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { Screen } from "@stax-ui/dom";

Effect.gen(function* () {
  const isMobile = yield* Screen.match("(max-width: 768px)");
  // isMobile : Readable<boolean>
});
```

## Router

Routes are declared with `Route.make(path).pipe(...)`; a router is
`Router.empty.pipe(...)` composing routes, layouts, fallbacks, error
handlers.

### Defining routes

```ts
import { Effect, Schema } from "effect";

import { Route, Router } from "@stax-ui/router";

// Static route: loader runs once at build (SSG) or per-request (SSR).
const HomeRoute = Route.make("/").pipe(
  Route.static({
    load: () => Effect.succeed({}),
    render: () => HomePage(),
  }),
  Route.meta({ title: "Home | My Site" }),
);

// Params + typed decoding via Effect Schema.
const UserRoute = Route.make("/users/:id").pipe(
  Route.params(Schema.Struct({ id: Schema.String })),
  Route.static({
    // For SSG, `paths` enumerates the params to pre-render.
    paths: () =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        const users = yield* discoverUsers();
        return users.map((u) => ({ id: u.id }));
      }),
    load: ({ params }) =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        return { user: yield* loadUser(params.id) };
      }),
    render: (data) => UserPage({ user: data.user }),
  }),
  Route.meta(({ data }) => ({
    title: `${data.user.name} | My Site`,
    description: data.user.bio,
  })),
);
```

Other Route combinators: `Route.render` (client-only render), `Route.get`
(loader + render for on-request data), `Route.post` / `.put` / `.delete`
(form/API handlers), `Route.searchParams(schema)`, `Route.rawParams`,
`Route.withGuard`, `Route.withAnimation`, `Route.scrollBehavior`,
`Route.lazy`, `Route.catchTag` / `.catchAll`.

### Composing a router

```ts
import { Router } from "@stax-ui/router";

export const router = Router.empty.pipe(
  Router.layout((children) => $.div({ class: "shell" }, children)),
  Router.concat(HomeRoute),
  Router.concat(UserRoute),
  Router.fallback(() => NotFoundPage()),

  // Route.params decoding can fail with ParseError. Handle it at the
  // router boundary to keep the error channel `never`.
  Router.catchTag("ParseError", (err) =>
    Effect.gen(function* () {
      yield* Effect.logError("Bad params", err);
      return yield* NotFoundPage();
    }),
  ),
);
```

Other Router combinators: `Router.guard`, `Router.prefixAll`,
`Router.scrollBehavior`, `Router.catchIf`, `Router.catchAll`.

### `Outlet` — where routed content renders

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { $ } from "@stax-ui/dom";
import { Outlet } from "@stax-ui/router";

import { router } from "./routes.js";

export const App = () =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    return yield* $.div(
      { class: "app" },
      Header(),
      Outlet({
        router,
        animate: {
          enterFrom: "opacity-0 translate-y-4",
          enter:     "transition-all duration-200",
          enterTo:   "opacity-100 translate-y-0",
          exit:      "transition-all duration-200",
          exitTo:    "opacity-0",
        },
        intro: true,
      }),
    );
  });
```

Pages inside the outlet can consume `OutletCtx` to coordinate their intro
animations off the outlet's enter group (see the animation sequences
example above).

### `Link` — SPA navigation

```ts
import { Link } from "@stax-ui/router";

Link({ href: "/about", class: "nav-link" }, "About");
Link({ to: UserRoute, params: { id: "42" } }, "View user");
Link({ href: "/settings", replace: true }, "Settings");
```

Signature: `Link<E, R>(props: LinkProps, ...children: PermissiveChildren<E, R>)`.

## Components

Plain functions returning `Effect<Element, E, R>` — nothing more.

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { $, Readable } from "@stax-ui/dom";

interface CardProps {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly onClick?: () => Effect.Effect<void>;
}

export const Card = (props: CardProps) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    return yield* $.div(
      { class: "card", onClick: props.onClick },
      $.h2(props.title),
    );
  });
```

For components with children, use `PermissiveChildren`:

```ts
import { $, PermissiveChildren, Element } from "@stax-ui/dom";

export const Panel = <E = never, R = never>(
  props: { class?: string },
  ...children: PermissiveChildren<E, R>
): Element.Element<HTMLDivElement, E, R> =>
  $.div({ class: ["panel", props.class] }, children);
```

Consume Effect services (Router navigation, custom `Context.Tag` services)
by yielding them inside `Effect.gen`.

## Types worth knowing

```ts
import type {
  ClassValue,             // string | Readable<string> | Array<ClassItem>
  ClassItem,              // one member of a ClassValue array
  EventHandler,           // <E extends Event> = (e: E) => void | Effect<...>
  PermissiveChildren,     // <E, R> = ReadonlyArray<ChildInput<E, R>>
  Children,               // strict child array (single-arg form)
  ChildInput,             // one child value (element, string, number, Readable, array)
  ChildLeaf,              // primitive child (no arrays)
} from "@stax-ui/dom";

import { Element } from "@stax-ui/dom";
// Element.Element<A, E, R>     — element type with correct generic order
// Element.Child<E, R>          — the effect-side child type
// Element.ChildNode            — the primitive result type

import { Readable, Signal, type SignalArray, type SignalMap, type SignalSet, type SignalStruct } from "@stax-ui/dom";
// Readable.Readable<A>
// Readable.Reactive<A>         — A | Readable<A> (accepted by many APIs)
// Signal.Signal<A>             — read + write
```

`Element.Element` is `Effect<A, E, Scope | RendererContext | R>` where
`A extends HTMLElement | SVGElement` — **DOM-node type first**, then error,
then requirements.

## Common patterns

### Services via `Context.Tag`

The idiomatic way to inject side-effects (storage, HTTP, config). Live impl
for the client, no-op impl for SSR/tests.

```ts
import { Context, Effect, Layer, Scope, Stream } from "effect";

import { Readable, Signal, type SignalArray } from "@stax-ui/dom";

export class Storage extends Context.Tag("my-app/Storage")<
  Storage,
  {
    readonly persistArray: <T>(
      key: string,
      defaults: readonly T[],
    ) => Effect.Effect<SignalArray<T>, never, Scope.Scope>;
  }
>() {}

// Live: persist to localStorage; write-through via a scoped fiber.
export const StorageLive = Layer.effect(
  Storage,
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    return {
      persistArray: <T>(key: string, defaults: readonly T[]) =>
        Effect.gen(function* () {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
          const initial = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as readonly T[]) : defaults;
          const arr = yield* Signal.Array.make<T>([...initial]);

          // Persist on every change; forkScoped ties this to the caller's scope.
          yield* Stream.runForEach(arr.changes, (value) =>
            Effect.sync(() => localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))),
          ).pipe(Effect.forkScoped);

          return arr;
        }),
    };
  }),
);

// No-op: server-side / tests. `set` calls are dropped.
export const StorageNoOp = Layer.succeed(
  Storage,
  Storage.of({
    persistArray: <T>(_key: string, _defaults: readonly T[]) =>
      Signal.Array.make<T>([]),
  }),
);
```

Provide layers at the top: `hydrate(App(), root, { layers:
Layer.mergeAll(makeClientLayer(router), StorageLive) })` on the client,
`layers` export in `entry.ts` for the server.

### Form handling

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect";

import { $, EventHandler, Signal } from "@stax-ui/dom";

export const LoginForm = () =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const email    = yield* Signal.make("");
    const password = yield* Signal.make("");

    const onSubmit: EventHandler<SubmitEvent> = (e) =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        yield* Effect.sync(() => e.preventDefault());
        const emailVal = yield* email.get;
        const passVal  = yield* password.get;
        yield* login(emailVal, passVal);
      });

    return yield* $.form(
      { onSubmit },
      $.input({
        type: "email",
        value: email,                                   // Readable — updates the DOM
        onInput: (e: InputEvent) =>
          email.set((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value),
      }),
      $.input({
        type: "password",
        value: password,
        onInput: (e: InputEvent) =>
          password.set((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value),
      }),
      $.button({ type: "submit" }, "Log in"),
    );
  });
```

Yield every `.set(...)` — it returns `Effect<void>`, not a synchronous
mutation. `@stax-ui/form` exists for schema-validated forms
(`Form.make`, `Field`, submit contexts) if you want more structure.

### Data loading

Prefer route loaders over `Boundary.suspense` for anything that could be
computed at build/request time — the loaded data is ready before the client
paints:

```ts
const PostRoute = Route.make("/posts/:slug").pipe(
  Route.params(Schema.Struct({ slug: Schema.String })),
  Route.static({
    paths: () =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        return (yield* discoverPosts()).map((p) => ({ slug: p.slug }));
      }),
    load: ({ params }) =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        return { post: yield* loadPost(params.slug) };
      }),
    render: (data) => PostPage({ post: data.post }),
  }),
);
```

Reach for `Boundary.suspense` for client-only fetches: user actions that
trigger a request, data behind auth, etc. `AsyncReadable` is the reactive
primitive underneath.

### Reactive destructuring

When a `render` callback receives a `Readable<Row>` and you want per-field
Readables:

```ts
import { Readable } from "@stax-ui/dom";

export const TodoItem = ({ todo }: { todo: Readable.Reactive<Todo> }) =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const row = Readable.normalize(todo);
    const { text, done } = Readable.valuesAt(row, ["text", "done"]);
    // text : Readable<string>, done : Readable<boolean>

    // The id doesn't change over the row's lifetime — capture it once.
    const id = (yield* row.get).id;

    return yield* $.li(
      { "data-done": done },
      $.input({ type: "checkbox", checked: done, onChange: () => toggle(id) }),
      $.span(text),
    );
  });
```

## Not covered here

Also exported and available (real APIs, out of scope for this quickstart):
`Portal`, `virtualEach` / `VirtualListRef` (windowed lists), `FocusTrap`,
`Keyboard` (bindings), `ScrollLock`, `UniqueId`, `Transition` (state
machines), `Mutation` (imperative-write helper), `Ref` (Effect-flavored ref
wrapper), `collect`, `provide`, `t` (template helpers).
